name: Microsoft 365
description: Business connector for Outlook mail, calendar and OneDrive/SharePoint files through Microsoft Graph. Read-only by default; writes are separate opt-ins and always need a person's approval.

tenantId.description: Directory (tenant) ID GUID or verified domain of the customer's Microsoft Entra tenant.

clientId.description: Application (client) ID of the app registration the administrator created.

enabled.description: Search and read OneDrive and shared files (Files.Read.All).

sharePoint.description: Search SharePoint sites and their libraries (Sites.Read.All).

mailSend.description: Allow sending mail (Mail.Send). Every send needs a person's approval.

mailDraft.description: Allow creating draft messages and draft replies, and attaching Project files to those drafts (Mail.ReadWrite, replaces Mail.Read). Drafts are never sent; a person sends them from Outlook.

files.description: Allow uploading Project files to the signed-in user's OneDrive app folder (Files.ReadWrite.AppFolder). Never writes outside that folder and never creates sharing links.

calendarWrite.description: Allow creating events (Calendars.ReadWrite). Every change needs a person's approval.

mailWatch.description: Autopilot m365.mail event triggers: one Graph delta-query watcher for this sign-in. Only the delta link is stored.

pollSeconds.description: How often subscribed mail folders are polled with a delta query.

notifications.description: Optional Graph change notifications (webhooks) on top of delta polling.

publicUrl.description: Public https base URL that reaches this gateway; Graph posts to <publicUrl>/plugins/microsoft-365/notifications. Polling stays on as the fallback.
